It is the color note pad you

have been waiting for a long time.

The Magic Note Pad transforms the way you read, write, and create with the amazing X-Paper Display.



Combined with the 16K ultrasensitive X3 Pro Pencil 2 and XPPen Notes, you can capture your inspiration with remarkable smoothness and efficiency.



Not only is it proud of its powerful functionality, but the slim and stylish Magic Note Pad is also your best productivity partner. Thanks to its native Android system, you can download various apps for office, education, and entertainment.

X-Paper Display===Read and Write As If On the Paper

X-Paper Key===One Press to Switch Between Three Color Modes

Magnetic Pen Slot===Store Your Pencil Easily

16.7 Million Colors===Restore the Original Color

90Hz Refresh Rate===Present Clear and Dynamic Contents

TÜV SÜD Certification===Low Blue Light, Easy on the Eyes

X3 Pro Pencil 2===16K Ultrasensitive Pressure Levels

XPPen Notes App===Wake Inspiration by One Click

Android 14 System===Open System, Countless Android Apps

Package List

Discover More Magic with Magic Note Pad

The Magic Note Pad is designed to meet the diverse note-taking needs of business and acadamics, aiming to enhance the work and study efficiency with comprehensive performance.

Specifications

Three Color Modes for

Immersive Reading

Forget about the limited color of e-ink. Simply press the X-Paper Key, and you can easily switch between three color modes to meet different needs.

Nature Color Mode===Present the original colors vividly and delicately

Light Color mode===Low saturation color display, release eye fatigue

Ink Paper Mode===Paper-like black-and-white display for immersive reading

Read or Write,

Just Like On Paper

The AG nano-etched display significantly reduces reflection and glare. Every letter you read or write appears as if it is on paper. The visual and tactile comfort of the Magic Note Pad makes it an exceptional tool for your creative process.

Restore The Original Color

Color matters for your creative process. The Magic Note Pad supports the display of 16.7 million colors with a brightness of 400nit. Its industry-leading color rendition capabilities not only enhance your reading and note-taking experience but also empower your creativity.

Every Pixel Displayed with High Quality

The display's refresh rate has reached 90Hz, a new benchmark for note pad. Each frame of the image is displayed with remarkable smoothness and clarity, greatly minimizing motion blur when watching fast-moving content.

Low Blue Light, Easy on Eyes

Magic Note Pad cares for your eyes. It has gained TÜV SÜD Low Blue Light Certification and Paper-like Display Certification. The display eliminates image flicker and minimizes harmful blue light as much as possible, making it more comfortable for your eyes.

Make Note-taking Easy and Efficient

Co-developed with Jnotes, a professional note-taking app developer, the XPPen Notes is a powerful native app that helps you take lecture notes, annotate documents, and create artistic paintings. Every function is designed to capture your bursts of inspiration, in-depth thinking, and creative expression at any time.

Industry-leading 16K Pressure Levels

The pressure levels of the note pad have reached a new peak. Powered by the X3 Pro smart chip, the X3 Pro Pencil 2 （Battey-Free） features ultra-sensitive 16K pressure levels, ensuring that every stroke you write is smooth and delicate.

Soft Pen Nib, Smoother Than Ever

You've got a new soft pen nib. Its shape is similar to that of a gel pen, making it suitable for writing. The soft pen nib also fits better to the display surface, achieving a paper-like writing experience.

Magnetic Slot,Easy Packing and Storing

The X3 Pro Pencil 2 supports magnetic suction. You can put the pencil in the pen slot. There is no need for charging or pairing. You can capture your inspiration or take a break immediately.

Download Countless

Apps in Google Play

Thanks to the native Android system, millions of apps from the Google Play are readily availablefor you. Whether you need applications for education, office, or entertainment, you can choose from a wide variety that meets your needs!

Strong Battery, Stay

All-time Active

The 8000mAh battery is powerful enough to support the Magic Note Pad for one week*. With a 20W charger, you can recharge the device quickly and efficiently. Say goodbye to battery anxiety from now on!
